issues.detail: Wikipedia is cited with supports:'level', but the fetched passage only says facultative reinsurance is purchased by the original underwriter while treaty is purchased by an outwards reinsurance manager/senior executive — it speaks to who buys reinsurance at the cedant, not the seniority of an assumed-reinsurance underwriter. Weak level support; the other two sources support the description well and the IC prior is reasonable, so judgment call only.

proposedOrgUnit Reinsurance / Facultative Placement verified: both exist in org-catalog.json and packet orgHome is null. The profile itself flags the placement as a vocabulary stretch (role also covers assumed treaty triage), which is a fair self-disclosure.

The Built In Sun Life 'Reinsurance Operations Manager' posting (builtin.com/job/7442069) was removed Feb 2026, but the page still serves the full posting content, which matches every claim made (treaty/facultative administration, bordereaux, settlements, internal controls, 2 years supervisory experience). Real source, not fabricated; consider re-citing an archived copy.

Profile description paraphrases the Google SRE charter slightly (omits latency/performance/efficiency) but does not misattribute anything.

The analyst-vs-manager ownership inversion is honestly disclosed in notes.

The Erie Insurance posting resolves and explicitly supports the Manager-level claim ('interviews, hires, trains and directs personnel'), justifying the recorded prior disagreement with Specialist/IC.

Both flags verified: 'Log Tax Authority Notice And Open Controversy Matter File' and 'Recommend Tax Efficient Investment And Capital Structuring' are real Owner sampleTasks, the Himalayas treasury-manager templates confirm no tax-controversy/structuring scope, and the Tax Director packet indeed holds the same controversy tasks as Participant — the swapped-ownership hypothesis is well evidenced.

The Built In Boston AIG 'Underwriting Quality Assurance Manager' posting (job 8095387) was removed Mar 2026 but still serves full content that matches the claims, including the 'liaison' framing the classificationFlag rationale relies on. The flag item 'Perform Post Engagement Qa Review Against Iia Standards' is a real Owner sampleTask in the packet. Real source; consider archiving.

summary.method: 3 roles sampled per batch (lowest confidence, one with classificationFlags or proposedOrgUnit, one other). All 32 cited source URLs for the 15 sampled roles were fetched: every URL resolved to real content supporting its claimed supports field (description/family/level). No fabricated or dead sources, no ungrounded invented claims beyond one borderline framing phrase (noted, Treaty Analyst), no invalid org units, no phantom flag items, and all roleFamily/roleLevel values valid. Three cited job postings are expired-but-still-served listings (Sun Life, AIG, AbbVie) — flagged as notes for archiving, not failures.
